perks.name: Rapid Repair
perks.description: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
perks.exact:
Upon healing Shield HP:
 10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1) and ?% Flinch Resist for 7 seconds.
Can only trigger once per Full Heal.

perks.name: Built from Scratch
perks.description: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
perks.exact:
Combatant Kills grant additional Ammo Progress based on their Ammo Type if Ammo Reserves are low.

Primary Ammo Weapons grant +3% Special Ammo Progress while Special Ammo Reserves <20%.
Special Ammo Weapons receive +2% Heavy Ammo Progress while Heavy Ammo Reserves <20%.
